root: ^Bella: Sorry I didn’t trust you at once. Living among these bloodsuckers has worn my sanity thin.
^ I’m guessing you’re here to hunt down my great‑great‑grandmother and end her reign of blood?
^Loras: Merlin’s beard... she’s a descendant of Vella?
^Bella: Only by blood. We’re nothing alike. Her reign was a deranged nightmare — the victims she kept up in that sky‑city...
^ But I’m not blameless. I’ve been training for a chance to bring her down, to finally lift this island’s curse.
^Cacildes: You want to take her on yourself?
^Bella: I want the Veilglade to be free of its nightly curse. For the water to remain water when the sun sets. For these soul‑sucking creatures to be laid to rest once and for all.
^ That’s all you need to know.
^Loras: Do you know where this city is?
^Bella: It’s not that simple — it’s a portal. Vella only opens the passage when she senses great power arriving on the island.
^ It may have opened when we fought, but its location shifts — never fixed, always moving somewhere across the island.
^Loras: I still think Bartolomeu might know more... maybe it’s time we see if the old skeleton’s finally awake.
^Bella: You’ll need me if you intend to bring down Vella. I won’t join on a whim — I’ll await a proper invitation. Talk to me again if you want my help.
